mapper.select: SELECT mm.id, mm.mv_name, mm.music_id, m.music_name, mm.duration, mm.cover_url, mm.release_time, mm.play_count, mm.like_count, mm.comment_count, mm.share_count, mm.is_vip, mm.status, mvr.quality_type, mvr.mv_url as quality_mv_url, mvr.file_size, mvr.is_vip_limit FROM music_mv mm LEFT JOIN music m ON mm.music_id = m.id LEFT JOIN mv_quality_relation mvr ON mm.id = mvr.mv_id WHERE mm.id = #{mvId} AND mm.status = 1

SELECT mm.id, mm.mv_name, mm.music_id, m.music_name, mm.musician_id, mu.stage_name, mm.duration, mm.cover_url, mm.mv_url, mm.release_time, mm.play_count, mm.like_count, mm.comment_count, mm.share_count, mm.is_vip, mm.status, mvr.quality_type, mvr.mv_url as quality_mv_url, mvr.file_size, mvr.is_vip_limit FROM music_mv mm LEFT JOIN music m ON mm.music_id = m.id LEFT JOIN musician mu ON mm.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN mv_quality_relation mvr ON mm.id = mvr.mv_id WHERE mm.music_id = #{musicId} AND mm.status = 1

SELECT mm.id, mm.mv_name, mm.music_id, m.music_name, mm.musician_id, mu.stage_name, mm.duration, mm.cover_url, mm.mv_url, mm.release_time, mm.play_count, mm.like_count, mm.comment_count, mm.share_count, mm.is_vip, mm.status, mvr.quality_type, mvr.mv_url as quality_mv_url, mvr.file_size, mvr.is_vip_limit FROM music_mv mm LEFT JOIN music m ON mm.music_id = m.id LEFT JOIN musician mu ON mm.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN mv_quality_relation mvr ON mm.id = mvr.mv_id WHERE mm.status = 1 ORDER BY mm.play_count DESC

SELECT mm.id, mm.mv_name, mm.music_id, m.music_name, mm.musician_id, mu.stage_name, mm.duration, mm.cover_url, mm.mv_url, mm.release_time, mm.play_count, mm.like_count, mm.comment_count, mm.share_count, mm.is_vip, mm.status, mvr.quality_type, mvr.mv_url as quality_mv_url, mvr.file_size, mvr.is_vip_limit FROM music_mv mm LEFT JOIN music m ON mm.music_id = m.id LEFT JOIN musician mu ON mm.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN mv_quality_relation mvr ON mm.id = mvr.mv_id WHERE mm.status = 1 ORDER BY mm.release_time DESC

SELECT mm.id, mm.mv_name, mm.music_id, m.music_name, mm.musician_id, mu.stage_name, mm.duration, mm.cover_url, mm.mv_url, mm.release_time, mm.play_count, mm.like_count, mm.comment_count, mm.share_count, mm.is_vip, mm.status, mvr.quality_type, mvr.mv_url as quality_mv_url, mvr.file_size, mvr.is_vip_limit FROM music_mv mm LEFT JOIN music m ON mm.music_id = m.id LEFT JOIN musician mu ON mm.musician_id = mu.id LEFT JOIN mv_quality_relation mvr ON mm.id = mvr.mv_id WHERE mm.status = 1 AND mm.is_vip = 1 ORDER BY mm.release_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE music_mv SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{mvId} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE music_mv SET collection_count = collection_count - 1 WHERE id = #{mvId} AND collection_count > 0
